# phb Paper Honeycomb Board — Full LLM Context

> Paper honeycomb board manufacturer in Balakong, Selangor, Malaysia (Quinocycle Sdn Bhd). Honeycomb boards, cargo boxes, and paper pallets — ISPM-15 exempt, 100% recyclable, up to 80% lighter than wood. Exporting worldwide via Port Klang and KLIA.

## Company Overview

phb Paper Honeycomb Board is the packaging brand of Quinocycle Sdn Bhd (SSM registration 202001029919). The company manufactures hexagonal-core kraft paper honeycomb products for industrial packaging, export pallets, heavy-duty crates, and structural panels.

## Products

All products share one engineered material: kraft paper formed into hexagonal cells and laminated between flat liners.

1. **Honeycomb board / panels** — rigid sandwich panels for layer pads, dividers, edge protection, furniture cores, displays, and structural packaging parts.
2. **Honeycomb cargo boxes & crates** — wooden-crate replacement for machinery, electronics, furniture, and project cargo.
3. **Honeycomb paper pallets** — export pallets weighing ~5kg vs ~25kg for wood.
4. **Protective parts** — die-cut fitments, corner blocks, edge protectors, void fill.

### Key Specifications (typical; every build is made to specification)

- **Pallet weight**: ~5kg vs ~25kg wooden pallet — up to 80% lighter
- **Compression**: engineered panels handle forces around 12kN; pallet-grade builds carry static loads comparable to plywood for typical export cargo
- **Cell size**: ~8–25mm; **core thickness**: ~10mm upward; paper grammage and liner grade tuned per load
- **ISPM-15 status**: fully exempt worldwide — processed paper is biologically inert; no heat treatment, fumigation, IPPC stamp, or phytosanitary paperwork in any destination country
- **Recyclability**: 100% — kraft paper with water-based adhesive, accepted by ordinary paper/cardboard recycling
- **Moisture**: standard board is NOT waterproof; moisture-resistant coating, PE lamination, or wax treatment available for humid routes. Permanently wet duty suits plastic or treated plywood better.
- **ESD**: standard kraft honeycomb is NOT an ESD-protective material; static protection comes from inner packaging (shielding bags, dissipative liners), with honeycomb as the outer structural/cushioning layer.

### Freight Savings Model (stated assumptions)

- ~20kg tare weight saved per pallet (5kg vs 25kg)
- At a typical air freight rate of US$4.50/kg (≈RM20/kg): ~US$90 (≈RM400) saved per air pallet
- ~US$45,000 across a 500-pallet programme
- Savings are largest on air freight; sea freight benefits come mainly from ISPM-15 exemption, payload within container weight limits, safer handling, and free disposal

## ESG Position

- Mono-material recyclable packaging: disposal at destination is free, and reportable as recycled rather than landfilled
- Sits in the lowest fee bands under EPR schemes and the EU PPWR (priced by material and recyclability)
- Tare-weight reduction lowers freight emissions per shipment — a quantifiable Scope 3 improvement
- No certification claims are made beyond material facts; specifications available for customer ESG questionnaires

## Customization & Export

Every product is produced to specification: dimensions (incl. rack-compatible and container-optimised footprints), density, die-cut fitments, coatings, and printed kraft liners. Process: customer sends cargo weight, dimensions, stacking plan, and transit route → engineered specification + quote → multi-density sample kit for testing. Supply ships flat-packed (dense) worldwide; full-container programmes or consolidated trial orders.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is ISPM-15 exempt paper honeycomb board?**
A: Paper honeycomb is biologically inert and fully exempt from ISPM-15 phytosanitary regulations worldwide. Unlike wood packaging, it needs no heat treatment, fumigation, or IPPC stamps.

**Q: How much weight does a honeycomb pallet save vs wood?**
A: A standard honeycomb pallet weighs ~5kg vs ~25kg for wood — about 20kg per pallet, roughly US$90 (≈RM400) in freight savings per air pallet at typical rates.

**Q: Is honeycomb board waterproof?**
A: No — standard board loses strength when saturated, like all paper products. Moisture-resistant coatings and PE lamination are available for humid routes.

**Q: Is honeycomb board 100% recyclable?**
A: Yes. Kraft paper and water-based adhesive go straight into ordinary paper recycling — no separation or specialist facility required.

**Q: Can phb export to any country?**
A: Yes — worldwide from Malaysia via Port Klang (sea) and KLIA (air). The ISPM-15 exemption applies in every destination market.
